// Fixture — should NOT be flagged (v1 limit, documented).
//
// An exported *Service method that takes a STRUCT input carrying
// an ID and reaches PathJoin without IsValidID. v1 does not flag
// because resolving the struct field type requires the type
// checker. Documented limit per the package doc; tightening to
// struct-aware analysis is a forward-arc Mantis.
//
// When v2 lands, this fixture should be moved to the "violation_*"
// set and the live-scan test will surface the consumers needing
// migration.

package fixture

type CreateInput struct {
	ID string
}

type Result struct {
	OK bool
}

type Service struct{}

func PathJoin(parts ...string) string {
	out := ""
	for _, p := range parts {
		out += p + "/"
	}
	return out
}

// Create takes a struct input — v1 does not introspect struct
// field types, so this is out of scope today.
func (s *Service) Create(input CreateInput) Result {
	path := PathJoin("/data", input.ID)
	_ = path
	return Result{OK: true}
}
